APP_HELP: USM video file demuxer and converter
HELP_INPUT: USM file(s) or directory(ies) containing USM files.
HELP_NO_CLEANUP: Do not delete decoded .ivf, .hca, and subtitle files when done.
HELP_VAPOURSYNTH: Use VapourSynth for video processing. Looks for matching .py scripts in vs/ directory.
HELP_HARD_SUB: Burn the default subtitle language into the video (re-encodes with x265). The output carries no soft subtitle tracks.
HELP_CRF: x265 CRF value when the video is re-encoded (--vapoursynth or --hard-sub).
HELP_PRESET: x265 preset when the video is re-encoded (--vapoursynth or --hard-sub).
HELP_X265_PARAMS: Custom x265 parameters (colon-separated). Replaces the built-in tuning.
HELP_JSON: Emit newline-delimited JSON events on stdout for a GUI/automation frontend.
HELP_PROBE: Read-only check what is available for each file (decryption key, local subtitles, VapourSynth script).
HELP_CRACK: Recover each file's decryption key from its own video stream and report it, without demuxing or converting.
HELP_UPDATE: Check GitHub for a newer release and update.
HELP_KEY: Manually supply the decryption key for a single file, as the decimal videoKey or, for a 7.1 file, audioKey:aesKey.
HELP_DEFAULT_AUDIO: Audio language to flag as default.
HELP_DEFAULT_SUB: Subtitle language code to flag as default.
HELP_FLAT: Write .mkv directly into the output directory without a parent folder.
HELP_VERSION: Display Charlotte's current version and exit.
